intent.proves: At least one active address is owned by an account rather than by a buyer.
intent.scope: AccessUserAddress rows whose owner is an account group; carrier rows excluded

bindings.reason: The tool answers one subject id at a time; a whole-host count needs a per-subject enumeration handler that is not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUserAddress a JOIN AccessUser g ON g.AccessUserId = a.AccessUserAddressUserId WHERE g.AccessUserType = 2 AND g.AccessUserUserAndGroupType = 'SystemAccount' AND ISNULL(a.AccessUserAddressActive,1) = 1 AND ISNULL(a.AccessUserAddressDefaultAddressCustomFields,0) = 0
